draft_message.subject: Trident Electrical & Air Conditioning — quoting and enquiry ideas
draft_message.body:
Hi Trident Electrical & Air Conditioning team,

I'm Dion from WEBSITES/BUISNESSaudits. I'd like to explore a few practical improvements for Trident Electrical & Air Conditioning, starting with website and mobile enquiry improvements.

Depending on your current setup, we could build:
- Clearer service pages and a smoother mobile enquiry journey on your existing website
- A guided enquiry form that collects job details before your team prepares a quote
- Prepared quotes and branded PDFs for your team to review

We could start with one small example, confirm the scope and cost, and build around the tools you already use.

Which enquiry or customer journey would you most like to improve?

Cheers,
Dion | WEBSITES/BUISNESSaudits

If this isn't relevant, reply "no thanks" and I'll leave it there.
